<script lang="ts">
import type { Variants } from 'motion-v'
import type { IconProps } from '@animate-ui/vue/icons'

export type MessageCircleDashedProps = IconProps<keyof typeof animations>;

export const animations = {
  default: {
    group: {
      initial: {
        rotate: 0,
      },
      animate: {
        transformOrigin: 'bottom left',
        rotate: [0, 8, -8, 2, 0],
        transition: {
          ease: 'easeInOut',
          duration: 0.8,
          times: [0, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1],
        },
      },
    },
    path1: {},
    path2: {},
    path3: {},
    path4: {},
    path5: {},
    path6: {},
    path7: {},
    path8: {},
  } satisfies Record<string, Variants>,
  draw: {
    group: {},
    ...(() => {
      const paths: Record<string, Variants> = {};

      for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
        paths[`path${i}`] = {
          initial: { opacity: 0, scale: 0 },
          animate: {
            opacity: [0, 1],
            scale: [0, 1],
            transition: {
              delay: i * 0.2,
              duration: 0.4,
            },
          },
        };
      }

      return paths;
    })(),
  },
} as const;
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { IconWrapper } from '@animate-ui/vue/icons'
import { motion } from 'motion-v'

defineOptions({ name: 'MessageCircleDashed', inheritAttrs: false })
</script>

<template>

    v-slot="{ variants, controls, size, attrs }"
    :animations="animations"
